title: Does Not Work Well
text:
Does Not Work Well. I bought the beeswax to replace plastic wrap and was really excited about it. However, the beeswax does not stay on Tupperware, plastic bowels, or glass bowels very well. The first time I used the beeswax, it worked ok at keeping air out, but the next few times I used the beeswax to keep air out while I stored food in the fridge, the seal was not air-tight and the food went bad faster because of it. Also, the beeswax has stuck onto several bowels and has not come off with multiple washings.

As excited as I was to try and replace plastic, beeswax comes nowhere close to being a decent substitute.

I will say, however, that the produce bags are wonderful. Would highly recommend them.
